subject: Working with designers and trade partners
hook: Send us this, and your parts come back right first time
ig:
Send us this, and your parts come back right first time.

For designers, fitters and makers using our trade workshop, most delays come from cutting lists that leave something open to interpretation. Here's what we need:

1. Finished sizes, length × width, and whether they include edging
2. Exact board decor and thickness, not just a colour
3. Grain direction marked on woodgrain parts
4. Which edges get ABS, and which thickness: 0.4, 1 or 2 mm
5. Drilling and grooves: hinge cups, shelf-pin rows, dowels, back grooves
6. Quantities and a label or part number for each piece

Get those six right and the parts arrive labelled, edged and ready to assemble, with no phone calls halfway through.

Save this for your next job. Ask for a priced cutting list through the link in bio.
fb:
For the designers, kitchen fitters and joiners who use our trade workshop: here's how to make your cutting list bulletproof.

We need finished sizes (length × width), the exact board decor and thickness, grain direction on woodgrain parts, which edges get ABS and at what thickness, any drilling or grooves, and a quantity and label for every part. With that, we can cut, edge and drill in our Hanley workshop without needing to check anything with you.

Trade and domestic orders welcome. Send us a list for a priced quote here:

on_asset: S1: A cutting list that works first time | Six things we need from you | S2: Finished sizes, length first — List every part as finished length × width, and say whether sizes include the edging. Length first, every time, avoids swapped dimensions. | S3: Board, colour and thickness — Give the exact decor name or code and board thickness. 'White' can mean five different products. | S4: Grain direction — Mark which way the grain runs on woodgrain decors, so doors and drawer fronts line up across a run. | S5: Edges per side — State which edges get ABS and which thickness: 0.4, 1 or 2 mm. A simple code per edge works well. | S6: Drilling and grooves — Hinge cups, shelf-pin rows, dowels and back-panel grooves, shown on a drawing or noted per part. | S7: Save this for your next order | Sizes. Board. Grain. Edges. Drilling. Plus quantities and part labels. Ask for a priced cutting list — link in bio
